source.value_definition: Serum IgG BAU/ml before/after vaccination in 127 paired participants
source.selection: All 127 pairs. Exact positive source numeric strings reshaped to one row per participant; source infection classification retained.
source.licence_evidence: Existing Urschel provenance records CC BY 4.0, 127 paired subjects, 254 supplied measurements.

candidate_changes: Actual two-class prior-infection identity uses the selected scWAT Fig. 2g blue/pink vector stroke colors as a raw-point adaptation
Point coordinates, opacity, size, legends and logarithmic axes retained; no fitted line added

transfer_probe.description: Rename numeric/unit fields and remove the optional group mapping using the complete 63-person no-prior-infection source stratum.

color_role_refinement.scope: Literature-informed colors are assigned by mark role and reading task; source biology and author styles are not reproduced.
